Life at Ocrolus

jobDescription:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer
About the Role
Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done — using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do
Agent architecture & orchestration
• Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
• Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
• Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
• Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend
Retrieval, grounding & context engineering
• Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
• Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection

• Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review
Integration & production craft
• Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
• Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk

title: Manager - Knowledge Management ((Corporate Law Firm))
jobDescription:
Candidates should have experience in Legal Industry, in Knowledge Management / Intellectual Property Management


Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Strong understanding of legal Knowledge Management principles and best practices.

  • Expertise in precedent management, content governance, taxonomy development, and legal knowledge organization.
  • Strong understanding of legal research methodologies and legal information resources.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise KM platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, legal technology solutions, and automation tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project and change management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

title: Lead Marketing Scientist
jobDescription:
About the Role

Lifesight is seeking a Lead Marketing Scientist to head a team of marketing scientists in developing advanced econometric and statistical models that solve complex marketing measurement problems. The role is anchored in scientific rigor and demands strong foundations in econometrics, causal inference, and statistical learning.

You will focus on building robust, interpretable, and scalable models - particularly in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) - while ensuring causal validity and statistical soundness. Beyond hands-on modeling, you will mentor a team of data scientists and shape the evolution of measurement methodologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Econometric Modeling MMM Development
  • Lead the design and implementation of Marketing Mix Models (MMM), formulating business problems as rigorous quantitative and statistical models.
  • Build models using regression-based approaches (linear and non-linear), time series methods for trend, seasonality, and forecasting, and Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks.
  • Incorporate core marketing science constructs, including adstock and lag effects, saturation and diminishing returns, and external drivers and control variables.
  • Ensure statistical robustness through proper model specification, parameter stability and interpretability, and sensitivity analysis.

Causal Inference Measurement Design
  • Apply causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and experimental and quasi-experimental designs.
  • Design and evaluate incrementality frameworks, including geo experiments and holdout testing.
  • Address endogeneity, confounding, and bias in observational datasets to ensure causal validity of model outputs.

Statistical Validation Diagnostics
  • Perform rigorous model validation, including residual analysis and diagnostics, multicollinearity checks, and out-of-sample and cross-validation.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics and ensure alignment with business outcomes.

Analytical Frameworks Model Integration
  • Develop integrated measurement frameworks that combine MMM, attribution, and experimentation.
  • Apply machine learning techniques where they enhance model performance without compromising interpretability.
  • Build scalable, reusable modeling approaches that strengthen the organization s measurement methodology.

Scientific Communication
  • Translate complex statistical outputs into structured, interpretable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Clearly articulate model assumptions, limitations, and implications, and support decision-making with evidence-based recommendations.

Team Leadership Capability Building
  • Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, establishing best practices in statistical modeling, code quality, and reproducibility.
  • Build team capability in advanced topics such as Bayesian modeling, causal inference, and experimental design.

Research, Delivery Collaboration
  • Stay current with advancements in econometrics, marketing science, causal inference, and statistical learning, and implement improved methodologies that enhance modeling accuracy and reliability.
  • Manage multiple analytical projects to defined timelines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure modeling outputs align with business needs.

Required Skills Experience
  • Experience: 8-12 years in advanced analytics, econometrics, or marketing science, with strong hands-on experience in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Technical expertise: Econometrics and regression modeling; time series analysis and forecasting; causal inference and experimental design; Bayesian statistics and hierarchical modeling (preferred).
  • Programming tools: Proficiency in Python or R, with strong experience in SQL and working with large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Master s or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience in marketing analytics or advertising measurement.
  • Exposure to SaaS-based analytics platforms.

Key Competencies
  • Strong quantitative and analytical reasoning, with scientific rigor and attention to detail.
  • Structured problem-solving and the ability to formulate ambiguous business questions as tractable statistical problems.
  • Clear, precise communication of technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to mentor and develop scientific talent.

What Success Looks Like
  • You create/help create statistically sound, interpretable MMM models delivered within Lifesight s methodology framework.
  • You Improve modeling efficiency by leveraging best-in-class AI to automate tasks and reduce manual effort.
  • You help create a high-performing, well-mentored team of marketing science professionals at lifesight.
  • Our clients are consistently satisfied and trust and act on our measurement insights.

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

title: Full Stack React Application Developer
tagsAndSkills: analytics platforms,application developer,ai,analytics tools,aws lambda,azure devops,analytics,azure functions
jobDescription:
Job Summary

React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
  • Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
  • Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Requirements

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
jobDescription:
Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do
  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Who You Are (Must-Haves)
  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)
  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

About Zenara

Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole-person, continuous and psychiatrist-led care.

Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care - while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision-making.

We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people-operations and executive-administration capabilities.

About the role

You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.

To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.

You will have access to sensitive information - employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add-ons to it.

What you will own 1. Recruitment coordination
  • Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
  • Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
  • Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
  • Organise and prioritise candidates for review
  • Coordinate first-round screening and interviews
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the process
  • Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
  • Send interview instructions, reminders and follow-ups
  • Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
  • Coordinate background and reference checks where required
  • Prepare candidate information for interviewers
  • Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
  • Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
  • Support offer, pre-boarding and onboarding administration
  • Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale

We are building technology-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.

2. HR and people administration
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
  • Track leave, attendance and other routine people-administration matters
  • Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
  • Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
  • Support the administration of employment agreements
  • Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
  • Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
  • Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
  • Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible

This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment-law or senior employee-relations advice.

3. Timesheets and payroll administration
  • Collect and monitor employee timesheets
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
  • Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
  • Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
  • Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
  • Track payroll-related questions and issues
  • Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation

You will not own payroll, compensation or employment-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.

4. Executive assistance
  • Provide trusted administrative support to our two co-founders
  • Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
  • Schedule internal and external meetings
  • Prepare agendas, action lists and follow-up trackers
  • Record or organise meeting actions where required
  • Follow up with team members on agreed actions
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
  • Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
  • Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
  • Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow-through

This will include practical, get-it-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.

5. Confidentiality and information management
  • Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
  • Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
  • Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
  • Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
  • Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
  • Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data-security issue immediately

You will be part of the trusted leadership-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.

Your first 60 days
  • Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
  • Review and organise existing employee and candidate records

title: District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
jobDescription:
Designation- District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
Programme- Strengthening Indias Agricultural Transformation- Rural Growth Hub Pilots
Reporting To- PMU Lead
Engagement Type- Fixed-term Employment
Locations (One Position for Each Location)- Bachhwara, Begusarai (Bihar) | Pallahara, Angul (Odisha) | Maregaon, Yavatmal (Maharashtra) | Indora, Kangra (Himachal Pradesh)

Vision for the Role
Athena Infonomics is supporting the NITI Aayog in the design and implementation of the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) programme- a three-year field engagement demonstrating how integrated, convergence-led agricultural transformation can be achieved at the village cluster level. The programme operates across five states - Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Himachal Pradesh- with one pilot district and one focus block per state.
The RGH is the operational centrepiece of this engagement. It brings together government schemes, frontier technologies, community institutions, and market linkages within a single village cluster as mutually reinforcing components of a coherent local development system. Rather than adding another layer to an already crowded programme landscape, the RGH works through what already exists: mapping farmers to schemes they are eligible for but not accessing, embedding technologies within existing government delivery channels, and strengthening the capacity of frontline officials to coordinate more effectively. The programme sits within a broader national architecture. PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY) provide a reference framework for scheme convergence across 100 aspirational agricultural districts that RGH could learn from and inform. The upcoming Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme (RPRP) is expected to provide a future financing pathway for scaling what the RGH pilots demonstrate.


The District Coordinator is Athenas single point of contact at the district and focus block level across all concerned departments. This is the role of the primary field intelligence anchor - someone sufficiently embedded in the district and block ecosystem to understand what is happening in practice, what are the opportunities for convergence and what needs to be enabled to make it happen, and how the RGH model can credibly strengthen farmer, village, and block-level outcomes. The District Coordinators ground-level judgement and documentation are the raw material from which the programme learns.


What You Will Own
  • Ground-level intelligence: a current, granular understanding of the agricultural and rural livelihoods landscape in your district and focus block - going beyond administrative data to understand what is happening in practice, how frontline officials are operating, and where scheme intent diverges from farmer experience, existing adoption level of technologies and the market for such services.
  • District and block action plan engagement: systematic gathering and analysis of the District Agriculture and Allied Activities Plan (DAAP) and block-level action plans wherever they exist, and contribution to the design of the Village Cluster Agriculture Action Plan (VCAAP) - the shared planning instrument anchoring the RGH cluster.
  • Intervention mapping, validation, and orchestration: a comprehensive, honest assessment of all active interventions in the focus block - government schemes, technology pilots, and civil society activities - evaluating what is working for which farmer profiles and documenting clearly where it is not. The role is primarily to inform the larger orchestration efforts towards matchmaking, prioritisations, additional activities to amplify impact by different stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder interface: Establish and manager primary working relationship with the District Collectors, District and Block Agriculture / Horticulture Officers, BDO, DPM-RL, Village Pradhans, Panchayat Secretaries, CRPs, KVK staff, and NRLM field functionaries - convening cluster coordination meetings and tracking scheme enrolment, delivery timelines, and institutional bottlenecks. The role also requires engagement with officials at the state level on areas where state level institutions, infrastructure and digital initiatives could be leveraged for scale up.
  • Technical and process documentation: weekly field observation logs, structured farmer feedback records, convergence opportunity matrices, technology adoption data, and monthly field intelligence reports - the mechanism through which ground-level learning becomes evidence that shapes programme adaptation and national policy.

Key Responsibilities

Scheme convergence and farmer-level mapping
  • Map every farmer in the RGH cluster to their current scheme enrolment status, eligibility gaps, and access barriers, building a convergence opportunity matrix per farmer profile and season. Build a strong and contextual understanding of focus schemes including underlying issues and challenges, areas for improvement etc.
  • Coordinate with block and district line department officers to unlock scheme access for eligible farmers, with particular attention to women farmers, SHG members, and marginal landholders. Track progress weekly against the programme target of a minimum of five schemes per farmer in the cluster.
Frontier technology assessment and deployment support
  • Assess existing frontier technology deployments in the focus block - drones, AI advisory systems, soil health tools, precision irrigation, digital crop surveys - evaluating adoption rates, farmer experience, and input efficiency outcomes.
  • Support identification and validation of additional technologies to be layered on existing interventions if any, ensuring they are embedded within government delivery systems and that data collection protocols meet programme standards.
Ground intelligence and field reporting
  • Maintain weekly field observation logs and prepare monthly field intelligence reports synthesising what is working, what is not, and what course corrections are needed.
  • Oversee conduction of structured farmer feedback sessions at the midline and endline, contributing to the programmes baseline-midline-endline survey framework and the generation of outcome data on farm income, yield, input costs, and market access.
  • Travel between the District Headquarters and Blocks as needed with a focus on project outputs and outcomes rather than activities.
Data systems and Shared Data Map maintenance
  • Maintain and update the Shared Data Map - the field-level data convergence instrument to ensure clarity on what data systems, parameters exist including information on data quality, validation status etc.
Community institution strengthening
  • Engage with SHG leads and KVK extension staff to assess the institutional capacity of community organisations around collective scheme enrolment, market linkage, and technology adoption and identify areas of support.

Additional Responsibilities

In addition to responsibilities under the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) Project, the selected candidate will be expected to support and contribute to other ongoing projects, assignments, and initiatives undertaken by Athena Infonomics in the state, as and when required. Such responsibilities may include project planning, stakeholder coordination, data collection and analysis, reporting, field implementation support, and any other tasks aligned with the candidates role, skills, and organizational priorities.

Who We Think You Are
You are likely to have between six and ten years of experience working at district /block / state level in agriculture, rural development, livelihoods, or related fields. You may have come through a social enterprise, an NGO, a government programme implementation role, a development consultancy, or a technology-for-development organisation. What matters most is whether you have spent substantive time at the district level collaborating with frontline officials, community institutions, and farmer households - and whether you understand how government actually works in the states where this programme operates.


You are genuinely curious about why things do not work. When a scheme is not reaching farmers, you want to understand the precise point at which it breaks down. You do not accept low awareness as a sufficient explanation. You have the patience to sit with a Block Agriculture Officer or a Panchayat Secretary and understand their actual operating constraints, not their official account of them. You write clearly - field reports that are honest about what did not work, specific about why, and clear about what it implies. You are at ease in a programme designed to learn and adapt rather than to deliver a fixed model.


WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BRING
  • A postgraduate qualification in agriculture, rural development, public policy, economics, social work, or a related discipline is the minimum educational requirement.
  • Between six and ten years of work experience, with at least three years in a district or block-level role in agriculture, rural livelihoods, or a related programme.
  • Direct prior experience of working with state government departments - particularly those relevant to agriculture, rural development, and livelihoods - in the state of the district you are applying for. This is a requirement, not a preference.
  • Demonstrated experience of working across a multi-stakeholder ecosystem comprising government line departments, self-help groups, civil society organisations, and private sector service providers.
  • Working familiarity with at least one government scheme MIS or data system - e.g., the NRLM portal, PM-KISAN, PM KUSUM, PMKSY, PM-DDKY, PMFBY, AgriStack, or equivalent - at an operational level.
  • Strong written communication skills in English and in the native language of the district of posting.
  • Exposure to frontier technologies in agriculture is an advantage, though not a prerequisite.

What Athena Offers
The District Coordinator role sits at the most consequential part of Athenas work - the point at which research, policy, and technology meet the reality of a farmers field. The programme is a national engagement with NITI Aayog, supported by a leading philanthropic organisation, and designed to generate evidence that informs how India approaches agricultural transformation at scale. The field intelligence you produce will feed directly into the formulation and design of the RGH models across the focus blocks.

You will work closely with the central PMU team at NITI Aayog and Athena s Core Project Team, with regular structured feedback and cross-district learning cycles built into the programme design. Athena is investing in building its agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice into a substantive national and international portfolio. For the right candidate, this role offers a genuine pathway into a growing organisation that values people who understand what is happening on the ground.

  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to development sector norms for district-level technical roles.
  • Travel support for district and block-level field visits and quarterly cross-district learning sessions.
  • Access to Athenas central research, data, and technology capabilities, including the APLYD AI and digital public infrastructure unit and the TolaData impact monitoring platform.
  • Structured mentorship from the central PMU team, with opportunities to growth within Athenas agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice. [1]

Application Requirements
Please note that the selected candidates would be stationed at the identified block within the district with frequent travel to the District Headquarter.
  • Updated CV - not exceeding three pages.
  • A covering note (maximum four hundred words) on: which block you are applying for, your most relevant prior experience, and one observation from your field experience that you believe is underappreciated in how agricultural programmes are designed or how frontier technologies could witness accelerated adoption in the country.

Athena Infonomics is an Equal Opportunities Employer

Athena Infonomics is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Level: Principal / Senior Director equivalent
Experience: 10-15 years
Location: Hyderabad, India (hybrid; some travel to US client sites)

About the Role
The Principal Outcome Manager owns business outcomes for our clients - not just projects. This is a senior consulting role that combines deep technology fluency, strong business judgment and disciplined delivery leadership.
It is not a traditional project manager role. The Outcome Manager agrees with the client up-front on what success looks like in measurable terms, leads the team that delivers it, tracks the outcome continuously, and stands behind the realized result.
In one line: agree the outcome, deliver the outcome, and make sure both the client and Tezo win.

Key Responsibilities
1. Discovery and outcome definition
  • Run discovery workshops with client business and technology leaders to uncover the real problem.
  • Translate the clients ambition into 2-4 measurable KPIs with clear baselines and targets.
  • Document and sign off the outcome, the measurement method and the review cadence with the client.
2. Shaping the engagement
  • Partner with sales and pricing to structure a fair, outcome-linked commercial that protects margin and gives the client real upside.
  • Identify risks early and decide - with leadership - whether to pursue, reshape or decline the deal.
  • Co-own the Statement of Work, ensuring every outcome term is unambiguous and measurable.
3. Execution and delivery
  • Build the right cross-functional pod (architects, engineering leads, data scientists, analysts) and set the operating cadence.
  • Drive day-to-day delivery through the leads. You do not write code, but you always know whether the work is on track to the outcome - and intervene early when it is not.
  • Manage scope, risks, dependencies and change with discipline.
4. Outcome tracking and realization
  • Stand up a simple outcome dashboard for each engagement: live KPI values against baseline and target, with leading indicators.
  • Run a weekly internal review and a regular client-facing outcome review. Convert lagging KPIs into corrective actions with owners and dates.
  • Close each engagement with a short outcome memo: what was committed, what was delivered, what the business impact was, what to repeat next time.
5. Stakeholder consulting and communication
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client business and technology sponsors - bring point of view, not just status updates.
  • Translate fluently between the CIO/CTO conversation (architecture, data, AI, technical risk) and the CXO conversation (revenue, cost, customer experience, time-to-market).
  • Manage escalations and disagreements directly; protect the relationship and the outcome at the same time.
  • Identify the next outcome and help grow the account.
6. People and team leadership
  • Lead the engagement pod with clarity on outcome and decision rights.
  • Coach engineering and consulting leads to think in outcomes rather than tasks.
  • Mentor junior consultants and outcome managers; help build the bench.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of Turium AI products and platforms, working closely with our engineering, AI, product and leadership teams.

This is not a traditional coordination-only project management role. We need someone who can own delivery, drive developers, remove blockers, challenge timelines and ensure high-quality product releases reach users on schedule.

You will be responsible for turning product vision and requirements into clear execution plans and ensuring the engineering team remains aligned, accountable and focused on shipping.

Key Responsibilities
Product Delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery across Turium AI products and technology initiatives.
  • Convert product requirements and leadership direction into clearly defined epics, user stories, tasks and milestones.
  • Build and maintain sprint plans, release plans and product delivery roadmaps.
  • Ensure features move efficiently from requirements development testing release.
  • Track dependencies between frontend, backend, mobile, AI and infrastructure teams.
  • Drive releases against ambitious timelines without compromising quality.
  • Identify delivery risks early and establish mitigation plans.
  • Maintain clear visibility of overall product readiness and release status.

Developer Management

  • Manage day-to-day execution across frontend, backend, mobile, AI and infrastructure development teams.
  • Run daily stand-ups and maintain clear ownership of every development activity.
  • Ensure developers understand requirements, acceptance criteria and priorities before development begins.
  • Track individual and team commitments against sprint objectives.
  • Challenge unrealistic estimates and identify delays before they impact releases.
  • Remove blockers quickly by coordinating across technical and business teams.
  • Ensure engineering teams maintain appropriate documentation, testing and code review practices.

Sprint & Agile Management

  • Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives and delivery reviews.
  • Maintain a prioritised and healthy product backlog.
  • Define clear sprint objectives and measurable deliverables.
  • Ensure every task has an owner, deadline and acceptance criteria.
  • Track sprint velocity, completion rates and delivery predictability.
  • Prevent tasks from remaining indefinitely "in progress."
  • Escalate missed commitments and recurring delivery issues quickly.
  • Continuously improve development processes and team productivity.

Quality & Release Management

  • Coordinate development, QA, UAT and production releases.
  • Ensure every major feature has appropriate test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain release checklists and go/no-go criteria.
  • Track bugs based on severity and customer impact.
  • Ensure critical defects are resolved before production release.
  • Coordinate post-release monitoring and issue resolution.
  • Maintain clear release notes and deployment status.
  • Drive continuous improvement based on user feedback and product performance.

Communication & Reporting

Provide leadership with concise daily and weekly updates covering:

  • Completed work
  • Current priorities
  • Upcoming releases
  • Risks and blockers
  • Delayed deliverables
  • Team capacity
  • Decisions required

Maintain a single source of truth for Turium product delivery, ensuring complete visibility around who owns each activity, its current status and when it will be delivered.

Escalate issues early rather than allowing deadlines to slip silently.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technology project management, product delivery or software engineering delivery.
  • Proven experience managing software developers and engineering teams.
  • Experience delivering modern SaaS, consumer applications or AI-powered products.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of frontend, backend, APIs, cloud infrastructure and mobile application development.
  • Experience managing Agile/Scrum development teams.
  • Strong experience with Jira, Linear or similar project management platforms.
  • Ability to understand technical discussions without necessarily being a hands-on developer.
  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail.
  • Strong ability to hold teams accountable while maintaining a productive working environment.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving technology environment with ambitious delivery targets.

Highly Desirable

Experience working with one or more of the following would be highly regarded:

  • AI / LLM-powered products
  • Real-time communication platforms
  • Voice and video applications
  • Consumer or enterprise mobile applications
  • React / Next.js
  • Go
  • Microservices
  • WebRTC
  • Authentication and identity platforms
  • Cloud-native environments
  • High-scale technology platforms

Success in This Role

Within the first few months, we expect the Project Manager to establish:

  • A clear Turium product roadmap and release calendar.
  • Predictable development sprints.
  • Clear ownership across every engineering activity.
  • Strong accountability across developers.
  • Early identification of risks and blockers.
  • Significantly improved delivery visibility.
  • Faster movement from requirement to production.
  • A disciplined release process.
  • Higher developer productivity and delivery predictability.
  • A culture where commitments, timelines and quality matter.

The Person We Want

We are looking for someone who is high-energy, organised, technically strong and obsessed with execution.

You should naturally ask:

What are we shipping
Who owns it
When will it be finished
What is blocking it
What needs to happen next

You must be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership, managing multiple engineering streams simultaneously and taking personal ownership for getting Turium products shipped.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to help build and launch ambitious global AI products rather than simply manage a project plan.

title: Sr Kubernetes Platform Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Role: You build the Kubernetes substrate that makes Kubogent possible.

Kubogent is a Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure and MLOps platform. A central control plane manages multiple workload clusters, allocates infrastructure to tenants and projects, deploys platform capabilities on demand, runs GPU and ML workloads, exposes remote operational access, and continuously reconciles desired state with what is actually running.

This role is for someone who understands Kubernetes as a distributed system and programmable control plane, not just as a deployment target.

Responsibilities

  • Own Kubernetes control loops. Design and build CRDs, controllers, operators, reconcilers, finalizers, watches, status models, and lifecycle state machines using Go and controller-runtime.
  • Build multi-cluster control. Help design and implement how Kubogent onboards, authenticates, observes, upgrades, and controls workload clusters that may only initiate outbound connections to the control plane.
  • Build the workload-cluster agent. Own registration, heartbeat, inventory, command execution, reconnect behaviour, versioning, rollout, credential rotation, and failure recovery.
  • Translate platform intent into Kubernetes state. Convert concepts such as project placement, capabilities, resource allocation, model deployments, notebooks, training jobs, and shared services into safe, idempotent Kubernetes reconciliation.
  • Own resource isolation and placement. Work with namespaces, quotas, limits, priority, scheduling, taints/tolerations, affinity, topology, GPU resources, gang scheduling, and workload placement.
  • Build GPU and accelerator support. Integrate with NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG where appropriate, node feature discovery, topology-aware scheduling, and accelerator-specific runtime requirements.
  • Build secure remote operations. Design mechanisms for browser-based kubectl/exec/log access, tunneled cluster connectivity, least-privilege credentials, mTLS, authorization, and auditable command execution.
  • Own cluster capability deployment. Build mechanisms that install only the operators and services required by capabilities enabled on projects or clusters, rather than treating every cluster as identical.
  • Design for unreliable environments. Clusters disappear, links break, agents restart, watches expire, APIs throttle, upgrades partially fail, and reconciliation gets repeated. Your systems must remain correct anyway.
  • Work deeply with Kubernetes API machinery. Informers, watches, admission, status conditions, server-side apply, resource versions, optimistic concurrency, garbage collection, RBAC, and API conventions.
  • Own platform upgrades. Design safe version skew, agent upgrades, CRD evolution, migration, backward compatibility, and rollout/rollback strategies.
  • Drive observability for the platform itself. Instrument operators and agents with logs, metrics, traces, health checks, queue depth, reconciliation latency, and actionable failure signals.
  • Set the bar. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and establish patterns for building reliable Kubernetes-native systems.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5-9 years | 4+ years building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, controllers, operators, or cloud-native infrastructure
  • 5+ years in software, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or cloud engineering, with substantial hands-on Kubernetes experience.
  • Strong Go. You should be comfortable designing production services, concurrency, interfaces, testing, profiling, and failure handling in Go.
  • Deep Kubernetes internals. Controllers, CRDs, reconciliation, API machinery, watches/informers, RBAC, admission, scheduling, storage, networking, and workload lifecycle.
  • You have built Kubernetes software, not only operated clusters. We especially value experience with Kubebuilder, controller-runtime, Operator SDK, custom schedulers, admission webhooks, or Kubernetes-integrated platforms.
  • Strong distributed-systems instincts. Idempotency, retries, at-least-once execution, eventual consistency, leases, leader election, partial failure, backpressure, and state convergence should be familiar ideas.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes across environments. Cloud-managed Kubernetes and on-prem/private-cloud experience are both valuable.
  • Comfort with networking. TCP/TLS, mTLS, proxies, reverse tunnels, WebSockets or streaming RPC, DNS, load balancers, ingress/gateway, and debugging connectivity failures.
  • Production troubleshooting ability. You can move from symptom to root cause across controllers, API servers, networking, scheduling, container runtimes, storage, and workloads.
  • Strong security fundamentals. Service identities, certificates, RBAC, secrets, credential rotation, least privilege, tenant isolation, and auditability.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools. We expect AI to accelerate implementation and investigation while you remain responsible for architecture, correctness, failure handling, and operational quality.

Strong pluses

  • Multi-cluster management platforms.
  • Kubernetes API aggregation or extension patterns.
  • Cluster API, Crossplane, Argo CD, Flux, Rancher, Rafay, Open Cluster Management, or similar systems.
  • Envoy, reverse tunnels, relay systems, or secure remote cluster access.
  • GPU scheduling, NVIDIA GPU Operator, MIG, CUDA-aware workloads, or distributed training infra
  • Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Loki, or Kubernetes observability stacks.
  • Kubernetes conformance, upgrade testing, chaos testing, or large-scale fleet management.

This role may not be the best match if

  • Your Kubernetes experience is primarily writing manifests, Helm charts, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. We are building Kubernetes-native control-plane software.
  • You expect infrastructure to be reliable and synchronous. Disconnected clusters, duplicate commands, partial upgrades, stale state, and repeated reconciliation are normal operating conditions here.
  • You prefer solving platform problems by adding manual operational procedures. Kubogent must turn those procedures into productized, automated control loops.

At Enterpret, we are building the customer feedback intelligence platform that turns unstructured customer feedback into a structured, queryable source of truth - solving complex problems in natural language processing, serverless computing, and analytics on the frontend, pushing the envelope of whats possible by applying first principle thinking.

title: Solution Architect - Shared Data Migration
jobDescription:
Job Summary

You are the Shared Data discipline Solution Architect responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end approach to migrating SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and Teams-connected file content during a global tenant-to-tenant M365 consolidation.

This role exists because shared data migrations fail when they re treated like a tool run . You will define the information architecture-aware migration blueprint: permissions fidelity, sharing behaviour, metadata, large content, throttling, delta strategy, validation, exception handling and stabilisation. You will ensure the factory can execute with repeatable patterns using third-party tooling (e.g., ShareGate or equivalent) and that wave migrations don t collapse into rework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define target-state information architecture and governance considerations relevant to tenant consolidation (sharing posture, permissions model, external sharing constraints, retention sensitivity, content ownership patterns).
  • Define the tenant-to-tenant ODSP migration strategy including discovery, mapping, staging, delta moves, cutover approach and post-move validation.
  • Standardise tooling approach (e.g., ShareGate / Quest / equivalent): configuration baselines, scheduling patterns, throttling management, reporting outputs and error handling.
  • Define runbooks for key migration tasks: site migrations, OneDrive migrations, Teams files migrations, permissions reconciliation, link/sharing remediation, metadata validation.
  • Set and enforce quality gates: ready to migrate , ready to cutover , accepted criteria including evidence packs and sampling methodologies.
  • Create the exception framework for difficult content (very large libraries, broken inheritance sprawl, customisations, third-party integrations, legacy workflows, blocked file types).
  • Define a repeatable approach to permissions and sharing parity (what is equivalent , what must be remediated, what requires business sign-off).
  • Lead escalation on complex failures: permissions anomalies, throttling, content mismatches, orphaned identities, broken sharing links, Teams dependency problems.
  • Produce operational metrics for factory execution: throughput, failure categories, rework rate, top blockers and continuous improvement backlog.
  • Align Shared Data cutovers to Identity/Devices/Teams readiness so user experience is protected.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Proven delivery of tenant-to-tenant SharePoint/OneDrive migrations at enterprise scale which must be evidenced.
  • Deep SharePoint Online/OneDrive expertise (permissions, sharing, IA, metadata, site templates, modern site constructs, governance controls).
  • Hands-on experience using ShareGate (preferred) or comparable enterprise migration tooling and ability to interpret logs and failure modes.
  • Strong understanding of Teams-connected content storage patterns and how Teams usage intersects with SharePoint/OneDrive.
  • Experience building factory-ready runbooks, validation gates and evidence packs to drive repeatable execution.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset: can isolate issues quickly, define a fix pattern and push it into standard practice.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience with highly regulated or complex governance environments (strict retention, compliance, sensitivity labelling interactions).
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation for checks/remediation (PowerShell/Graph).
  • Knowledge of common ODSP migration pitfalls: link behaviour, sharing model differences, permissions sprawl, performance constraints, change windows.

Interpersonal Consulting Skills

  • Can drive standards adoption across multiple teams and regions without becoming a blocker.
  • Clear communicator of data risk and end-user impact; no false confidence.
  • Bases trust with business content owners through clarity, not jargon.
  • Maintains a high-quality bar and reduces rework through proper readiness control.
  • Coaches the factory SMEs; enables scaled delivery rather than acting as a bottleneck.

Shift / Working Pattern

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

title: Manager - Strategic Partnerships ( Institutional Grants & HNIs)
jobDescription:
Manager - Strategic Partnerships ( Institutional Grants & HNIs) Location: Noida | Travel across India as required Reports to: Director - Strategic Partnerships About Muskaan Dreams We believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future. Every day, millions of children walk into government school classrooms with the same curiosity, dreams, and potential as children anywhere else. But as technology and AI rapidly reshape how we learn, work, and solve problems, access to the skills and opportunities needed to thrive remains deeply unequal. We exist to change that. At Muskaan Dreams, our work begins with children and teachers. We spend time in classrooms, listen deeply to teachers, understand the realities of government schools, and design solutions that can work in the real world, not just in pilots. We dont believe lasting change can be created by building parallel systems. We believe in strengthening the public education system itself. That means working alongside teachers, school leaders, district administrations, and state governments so that solutions can be adopted, sustained, and eventually reach millions of children. Over the last decade, this belief has taken us from working with a handful of schools to reaching nearly 1 million children, 5,000+ government schools and 15,000+ teachers across six states. But for us, scale is not simply a number.
  • Scale means a teacher feels more confident in her classroom.
  • It means a child in a government school beginning to see herself as a problem-solver and creator.
  • It means an education system becoming capable of sustaining change long after a programme or funder has exited.
Our ambition is to ensure that children in Indias government schools are not simply consumers of technology, but become confident problem-solvers, critical thinkers, creators, and future-ready citizens.


Our Flagship Initiatives Digital Shaala Digital Shaala transforms government school classrooms into engaging, technology-enabled learning environments. Through enabling existing interactive digital devices, curriculum-aligned digital content, teacher capacity building, and academic mentoring, the programme strengthens Science and Mathematics learning while nurturing students curiosity, confidence, and interest in STEM education and careers. AI-Saksham AI-Saksham prepares students and teachers for an AI-enabled world. Through experiential, classroom-integrated learning, students develop foundational AI literacy, computational thinking, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. The programme empowers young people with the skills and confidence needed to thrive in the future while enabling teachers to integrate AI and computational thinking meaningfully into classroom learning. As India prepares millions of young people for an AI-driven economy, we believe government schools must be at the heart of this transformation, not left behind by it. Our Next Chapter Muskaan Dreams is entering a defining phase of growth. Today, we manage an annual budget of approximately 20 crore, supported by leading corporations, foundations, philanthropies, and ecosystem partners. Over the next 2-3 years, we aim to grow this into a 50 crore annual portfolio through a diversified and sustainable fundraising strategy built on long-term institutional partnerships rather than transactional grants. Our larger ambition is to reach and impact 10 million children over the next five years while building one of Indias leading organisations working at the intersection of AI, education, and government system transformation. Achieving this will require more than funding. It will require a coalition of corporations, foundations, philanthropists, governments, technologists, educators, and leaders who share our belief that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

About the Role We are looking for a Manager - Strategic Partnerships who can help us build and grow meaningful partnerships with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, institutional donors, and grant-making organisations in India and globally. This is not simply a proposal-writing or grant-management role. You will be expected to identify opportunities, open conversations, build relationships, develop compelling proposals, convert opportunities into partnerships, and nurture those relationships over time. You will own a portfolio of prospective and existing partners and be accountable for moving relationships from: Research Relationship Opportunity Proposal Partnership Stewardship Renewal & Growth Working closely with the Director - Strategic Partnerships, CEO, Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams, you will help translate our ambitions, evidence, and stories from the ground into partnerships that enable impact at scale. We are looking for someone who is a relationship builder, storyteller, opportunity creator, and partner advocate. What You Will Own 1. Build New Institutional Partnerships | 50% You will proactively identify and cultivate relationships with:
  • Indian and international foundations
  • Philanthropic institutions
  • Family offices
  • Donor collaboratives
  • Bilateral and multilateral agencies
  • Global grant-making organisations
  • Other mission-aligned institutional funders
You will:
  • Research and qualify high-potential funding opportunities.
  • Build a healthy pipeline of prospective partners.
  • Proactively initiate conversations rather than relying only on incoming opportunities.
  • Understand funder priorities, strategies, geographies, grant cycles, and decision-making processes.
  • Build relationships with relevant decision-makers.
  • Identify areas of alignment between partner priorities and Muskaan Dreams programmes.
  • Move qualified opportunities systematically towards partnership.
The expectation is clear: you will not only manage opportunities, you will help create them. 2. Develop Compelling Proposals & Funding Opportunities | 15% Once an opportunity is identified, you will help convert our work into a proposition that a partner can understand, believe in, and support. You will lead:
  • Concept notes
  • Grant proposals and applications
  • Partner presentations
  • Budgets
  • Logical frameworks
  • Theories of Change
  • Implementation plans
  • Due diligence documentation
  • Supporting grant documentation
You will work closely with Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams to bring together programme design, evidence, budgets, government context, impact data, and stories from the field. 3. Own Partner Relationships & Partner Success | 15% Fundraising does not end when the grant is signed. You will own relationships with a portfolio of existing partners and ensure that their experience with Muskaan Dreams is thoughtful, transparent, responsive, and impact-focused. You will:
  • Build trusted relationships with partner teams and leadership.
  • Ensure timely and high-quality communication.
  • Coordinate reporting and impact updates.
  • Organise review meetings and field visits.
  • Ensure commitments and deliverables are tracked internally.
  • Surface challenges proactively and transparently.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for partners to experience the work.
  • Identify opportunities for renewals and expansion.
  • Bring partner feedback and perspectives into internal conversations.

Our ambition is that partners dont simply fund Muskaan Dreams. They should become champions of the impact we are creating together. 4. Build Strong Partnership Systems & Intelligence | 20% Strong fundraising needs strong systems. You will:
  • Maintain an accurate fundraising pipeline and CRM.
  • Track opportunities, conversations, next actions, and probabilities.
  • Maintain grant calendars and submission deadlines.
  • Build institutional knowledge about funders and previous engagements.
  • Track philanthropic and funding trends.
  • Develop intelligence around emerging thematic and geographic opportunities.
  • Ensure partnership documentation is organised and accessible.
  • Use pipeline data to support fundraising planning and decision-making.
Partner Success Is Central to This Role We believe successful partnerships are built on trust, transparency, shared purpose, and measurable outcomes. We want every partner to feel that:
  • They understand the impact their support is creating.
  • Communication is timely, transparent, and proactive.
  • Commitments are honoured.
  • Challenges are communicated openly.
  • Their priorities and feedback are genuinely heard.
  • They remain connected to the programmes and communities they support.
  • Impact is communicated through both evidence and powerful storytelling.
  • Muskaan Dreams thinks beyond one grant cycle.
Ultimately, we want partners to see Muskaan Dreams as an organisation they trust, value, advocate for, and want to continue working with.



What Success Looks Like Build a Strong Pipeline Develop and consistently maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified Indian and global institutional funding opportunities aligned with Muskaan Dreams priorities. Convert Opportunities into Partnerships Take ownership of moving qualified opportunities from initial research and conversations through proposals, due diligence, and partnership closure. Build High-Quality Funding Propositions Consistently develop compelling, evidence-backed proposals and presentations that clearly communicate the problem, our approach, expected impact, and case for partnership. Grow & Retain Existing Partnerships Build trusted relationships that result in strong partner satisfaction, timely renewals, multi-year partnerships, and opportunities for expansion. Create an Excellent Partner Experience Ensure partners experience Muskaan Dreams as responsive, transparent, thoughtful, credible, and committed to impact. Strengthen Fundraising Discipline Maintain accurate pipelines, CRM, grant calendars, documentation, and follow-up systems so that opportunities dont get lost because of weak execution. Who Were Looking For Experience
  • 4-6 years of experience in institutional fundraising, philanthropy, partnerships, international development, grant management, programme development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing and/or managing institutional grants.
  • Experience working with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, bilateral/multilateral agencies, or institutional donors.
  • Strong experience developing concept notes, proposals, presentations, budgets, and donor reports.
  • Experience directly engaging with external partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience in education, technology, public systems, international development, or social impact would be valuable.
Capabilities We are looking for someone with:
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong storytelling and proposal-writing skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building ability.
  • Strong research and opportunity-identification skills.
  • Confidence initiating conversations with new partners.
  • Ability to understand funder priorities and identify strategic alignment.
  • Strong stakeholder and project-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple proposals and relationships simultaneously.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • High attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfort with targets, pipelines, and fundraising accountability.
  • Willingness to travel across India and internationally when required.
Who You Are Matters to Us Experience matters. But so does how you approach the work. We are looking for someone who:
  • Deeply cares about children, education, and equitable opportunities.
  • Is naturally curious about people and enjoys building relationships.
  • Believes partnerships are built on trust and shared purpose, not transactions.
  • Is comfortable reaching out, opening doors, and creating opportunities.
  • Listen before proposing solutions.
  • Can communicate complex ideas simply.
  • Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Is responsive and dependable.
  • Is resilient-because fundraising requires patience and persistence.
  • Shares credit and believes in collective success.
  • Demonstrates integrity, humility, professionalism, and maturity.
  • I am excited by the opportunity to help build something ambitious.
This role may not be right for you if:
  • You see fundraising primarily as writing proposals.
  • You prefer waiting for RFPs rather than proactively creating opportunities.
  • You enjoy closing grants but not maintaining relationships afterwards.
  • You prefer transactional fundraising over long-term relationship building.
  • You are uncomfortable reaching out to new people or engaging senior stakeholders.
  • You struggle to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • You find follow-ups uncomfortable.
  • You struggle with deadlines, details, or structured pipeline management.
  • You prefer working independently rather than coordinating across teams.
  • You are uncomfortable being accountable for fundraising outcomes.
Why Join Muskaan Dreams Because this is an opportunity to do more than raise funds. You will help build a coalition of institutions and people who can influence what the future looks like for millions of children. You will work at the intersection of AI, education, government systems, philanthropy, and social impact. You will spend time with funders and leaders-but also with teachers, children, programme teams, and government stakeholders whose realities should shape every partnership we build. And as Muskaan Dreams grows, you will have the opportunity to build relationships, systems, and partnerships that grow with it. If you believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future, we would love to hear from you.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. This is a builders role at the frontier of a fast-moving field handson, high-ownership, and directly influential in making responsible AI adoption real at a global scale. If you are excited about defining what secure AI looks like inside a world-class organisation, apply now and become part of Team Orange.

  • You assess AI tooling and AI-built applications across SIXT, identify and derive associated security risks, and present clear, actionable findings to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making
  • You author remediation policies that keep AI usage inside agreed boundaries, automating enforcement so it does not depend on manual review
  • You partner with teams and business units building their own AI-powered tools, steering them toward more secure approaches and making risk-based decisions on what AI usage is acceptable
  • You define the baseline of healthy, productive AI usage that SIXT should actively encourage, and track progress through clear KPIs that show how risk is being reduced over time
  • You respond to AI-related security incidents, containing issues quickly and decisively, and work continuously with security and engineering teams to improve and automate AI governance controls
  • You partner with Security, Legal, and Data Protection colleagues to keep AI usage aligned with the EU AI Act, GDPR, and other evolving regulatory obligations
